questions.question: What is the difference between language and structure analysis?

points.text: Language analysis looks at word choice and literary devices; structure analysis looks at how the text is organised and sequenced.

questions.question: Why might a writer use a short paragraph?

points.text: To create impact, drama, tension, or to draw attention to a key moment or idea.
Starting in the middle of the action - a narrative technique that creates immediate engagement.

questions.question: How can sentence length affect the pacing of a text?

points.text: Short sentences speed up pacing and create tension; long sentences slow pacing and allow for detailed description.
